notes.title: We're working on a new game!
notes.content:
pssst... hey you, yeah you.

We've been cooking up something we think you might like,

[h1][b]Announcing Kaiju Fishing![/b][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043110/Kaiju_Fishing/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33072170/1b3fb0df7d3f580f8d49507662d7ec54d252412c.jpg[/img][/url]

If fishing for giant monsters sounds like fun, and honestly how could it not, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1043110/Kaiju_Fishing/]Wishlist now[/url]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33072170/08bb5b57d1d74e1f05b637fd0dd3e540a5a9097f.gif[/img]

We'll be mailing out Devblogs and recruiting playtesters from our [url=https://mutantstudios.us17.list-manage.com/subscribe/post?u=85b805dee76e56d08d9ba0136&id=bb2339b3b2]Mailing list[/url], and our [url=https://discord.gg/Meuq8ea]Discord[/url]. We hope you'll join us as we bring the world of Kaiju Fishing to life.

As always, thanks for playing!

Jeff and the Mutant Studios Dev Team
